Method.name: OnMessage
OnStreamRequest
Method.Implementation: set stat = $$$OK #dim tFilePath,tFileName As %String="" $$$TRACE("Inside OnStreamRequest..") try { set tFilePath=##class(Ens.Util.File).fixPath(..TempFilePath) set tFileName=##class(Ens.Util.File).CreateTimestamp("",..TempFileName) $$$TRACE("Converting Stream to File "_tFileName) set tFileName=tFilePath_tFileName OPEN tFileName:("WNR"):15 USE tFileName do pRequest.Stream.OutputToDevice() CLOSE tFileName }catch errobj { $$$LOGERROR("Error in OnStreamRequest " _ errobj.AsSystemError() _ " _ data: " _ errobj.Data _ "; code:" _ errobj.Code) set stat = $$$ERROR("Error in OnStreamRequest " _ errobj.AsSystemError() _ " _ data: " _ errobj.Data _ "; code:" _ errobj.Code) set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringContainer).%New() set pResponse.StringValue="FAILURE" } if ($$$ISOK(stat)){ set requestMQ=##class(Ens.StringContainer).%New() set requestMQ.StringValue=tFileName set stat=..OnMessage(requestMQ,.pResponse) } if (##class(%File).Exists(tFileName)){ do ##class(%File).Delete(tFileName) } return stat

Method.name: OnInit
Method.Description: This user callback method is called just after %OnNew() to initialize the connection among other things. If you need to override this code, invoke the method in the superclass or add to the original code.
